title: Canada perils
text:
Canada perils

The following table lists the
 perils
 and peril codes that 
Touchstone
 supports for
 Canada.

| Import peril code | Peril | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PAL | All licensed perils | |
| PEA | All earthquake perils | |
| PFF | Fire (fire following earthquake) | |
| PES | Earthquake shake only | |
| PFL 1 | Inland flood | |
| PTS | Tsunami | |
| PWA | All wind perils (tropical cyclone and severe storm) | |
| PWW | Winter storm | |
| PWF | All wind plus fire | |
| PWH | Tropical cyclone | |
| PWT | Severe thunderstorm | |
| PWX | Severe storm (wind excluding tropical cyclone) | |

1
 Added in v12.0
